title: MAGIC: Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration for VLM Test-time Robustness Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.32013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies the problem of test-time robustness scaling for large vision-language models (LVLMs), which aims to mitigate language bias during inference. Existing approaches typically adopt test-time scaling techniques such as contrastive decoding to improve inference performance. Despite the progress, the performance of these approaches is far from satisfactory due to intentional evidence removal during perturbations and redundant inference cost. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration (MAGIC). The core of our MAGIC is to evaluate the decision margins of LVLMs to selectively activate textual and visual perturbation branches for efficient debiased inference. In particular, our MAGIC first measures the prediction margins of crucial tokens, and applies a gating function to identify low-confidence responses that are susceptible to language biases. translated_title: MAGIC：面向视觉语言模型测试时鲁棒性扩展的边际门控对比去偏与证据恢复方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的测试时鲁棒性扩展问题，旨在缓解推理过程中的语言偏见。现有方法通常采用对比解码等测试时扩展技术来提升推理性能。尽管取得了一定进展，但由于扰动过程中证据被刻意移除以及推理成本冗余，这些方法的性能仍远不能令人满意。为此，我们提出了一种名为边际门控对比去偏与证据恢复（MAGIC）的新方法。MAGIC 的核心在于评估 LVLMs 的决策边际，以选择性地激活文本和视觉扰动分支，从而实现高效的去偏推理。具体而言，MAGIC 首先测量关键 token 的预测边际，并应用门控函数来识别易受语言偏见影响的低置信度响应。对于被选中的……
tldr: 提出了MAGIC方法，通过测量关键token的决策边际并利用门控机制，仅对易受语言偏见影响的低置信度响应选择性激活文本与视觉扰动分支进行对比去偏，同时结合证据恢复，实现高效且鲁棒的视觉语言模型测试时推理。
en_tdlr: MAGIC proposes a margin-gated contrastive debiasing framework with evidence restoration that selectively activates textual and visual perturbation branches only for low-confidence responses susceptible to language bias, enabling efficient test-time robustness scaling for vision-language models.
